nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: Good evening. Welcome to the Blue Bay Hotel.
Good evening. I have a reservation. My name is Carlos Mendoza.
One moment, please. Yes, Mr. Mendoza. A single room for three nights.
That's right. What time do you serve breakfast?
Breakfast starts at seven and finishes at ten, in the restaurant on the ground floor.
Yes, it does. The password is on the card, with your key.
Great. And does the hotel have a gym?
No, it doesn't, sorry. But there's a pool on the roof. It opens at eight in the morning and closes at nine at night.
Perfect. Do you book taxis for guests? I need a taxi to the airport on Friday.
Yes, we do. What time do you need it?
No problem. Your room is four oh two, on the fourth floor. The elevator is on the left.
